test.test_input: Create a wholly fictional symbolic life journey, not a real person or real ultrasound medical record.
test.adaptation: ChatGPT适配测试，非原指定模型实测
changes: 填充虚构人物/年龄；其他要求保留，非原示例人物实测。
test.selected_source_prompt:
A powerful cinematic collage storytelling the complete life journey of a woman in one frame.
The story begins on the far left with a black-and-white USG ultrasound scan, softly glowing, showing the unborn baby. Flowing seamlessly into the center, the collage transitions through life stages: a newborn wrapped in hospital cloth, a toddler taking first steps, a schoolgirl with a backpack, a teenage girl with dreams in her eyes, a confident young woman building her career, a mature woman filled with strength and wisdom.
On the far right, the story ends with an elderly lady sitting peacefully by a window, silver hair glowing in warm sunset light, symbolizing fulfillment and reflection.
Each stage blends into the next using torn paper edges, light leaks, soft motion trails, floating memories, clock elements, and subtle timelines.
Color grading evolves from cool monochrome (birth) to vibrant warm tones (youth) and finally to golden, soft hues (old age).
Ultra-emotional, poetic, cinematic storytelling, shallow depth of field, realistic human expressions, high-detail collage composition, symbolic life journey, timeless and inspirational
